item: Field checks: the checks only the operator's machine can run (R603)
status: built; live fetches unverified here (the sandbox blocks the hosts, which is why they exist)
summary: A Field checks box under the Diagnostics buttons runs, on a press, what CI and the sandbox cannot: import memory and disk headroom (the merge's own check), backup-drive speed (scratch file, deleted), live GISTEMP/USGS/OWID and all four IPCC SPM PDFs, the five thesaurus hosts, the browser multi-download, the clock-step record. Versioned manifest, each check says why, who added it and when it retires; online-ness is the runner's, consent-gated; results in memory; report scrubbed. A PR that ships something only the field can confirm adds its check in the same PR.
